_comment: Vertical 9:16 build of the two picks in shortlist.json. Cut from the clean source, never from a captioned master: captions are re-rendered at vertical size after the crop so the crop cannot slice them. The handle is a placeholder: these renders are a local macOS check of the pipeline and are not published anywhere. The caption preset is bloomberg-tech-vertical, whose bottom_margin_px 816 was measured on THIS episode: clearing Bloomberg's own lower third forces crop_zoom up, which magnifies the face until nothing fits between the chin and the Shorts UI, so the card goes above the head.

captions._bottom_margin_why: Overrides the preset's 816, which was measured on a tighter framing of this same episode (crop_zoom ~1.556-1.714 to clear Bloomberg's lower third). These clips are reframed without that zoom, so the faces sit higher and 816 put the card on the chin: 10 FAIL, worst 18% cover, clearance -9..-101 px. Swept with check-caption-space.py, which needs no encode. Read the two numbers it gives you separately: the standalone sweep measures the PLAN and said 900 cleared both clips (+58 / +48 px), while the same check run against the RENDER put clip 02 at -55 px and 3 warns. The render is the one that counts. 950 is the value that clears both on the render.
